title: pcountr: Interactive Stratigraphic Grain Counter with PCount Legacy Support
description:
An interactive, keystroke-driven counting application for recording stratigraphic assemblages at the microscope — pollen, diatoms, charcoal morphotypes, or any proxy counted by traversing a slide. Counts are saved continuously to a self-contained YAML format carrying identifications, metadata, depth and age.

Provides report calculations (assemblage sums, tracer-spike ratios, concentrations, traverse statistics, preservation tabulations), rarefaction-based count targets derived from an extrapolated richness asymptote, a wide samples-by-taxa matrix for stratigraphic plotting, accumulation rates, and export to Tilia XML (.tlx) for Neotoma integration and upload. Region-specific taxon dictionaries can be drafted from Neotoma records near a coordinate.

Also reads and converts legacy MS-DOS PCount .CNT count files and their .DIC dictionaries; count_metrics() has been verified to the digit against an original PCount .RPT report. Chronology construction is delegated to dedicated tools such as rbacon and clam.

Dedicated to the memory of Dr. Eric C. Grimm (1951–2020), who developed PCount at the Illinois State Museum and distributed it freely to the palynological community from 1994.
